judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer does not mention the value E_nn=4.900×10³ MeV fm³, does not cite Kobyakov:2013eta, and does not challenge any numerical value from Table I of that paper. No flag corresponds to this injection.

The review excerpt contains no mention of Ref. Kobyakov:2013eta, Table I, E_nn, or any challenged numerical value from that citation. Under the value-or-numeric rule, this injection is not specifically flagged.
The reviewer report is truncated and does not mention Section 4.2, the specific numerical value of Enn, or the cited paper Kobyakov:2013eta.

The reviewer never mentions Z=280 or any inconsistency in the proton number of the nuclear cluster. The report is cut off mid-sentence and focuses only on dimensional issues in Eq. (17), with no reference to Z values.

The review excerpt does not mention the proton number inconsistency Z=280 versus Z=28, nor any conflict between the setup paragraph and figure/table captions or results. No specific detection of this numeric inconsistency appears.
The reviewer does not mention the inconsistency in the proton number Z or any of the specific locations (setup paragraph vs captions) where the error occurs.

The reviewer's mathematical critique focuses on a missing factor of k and dimensional mismatch in Eq. (17), not on the missing factor of 2 in the normalization prefactor of the transition-density formula (eq:trans_analytic). These are distinct equations and the injection is not flagged.

The reviewer flags a different mathematical issue: 'Dimensional mismatch and missing wavevector in Eq. (17)' and says Eq. (17) is missing a factor of k. The injected error is instead a dropped factor of 2 in the normalization prefactor of Eq. eq:trans_analytic in Sec. 3.2, so this does not correspond to the injection.
The reviewer flags a dimensional inconsistency in Eq. (17), but fails to identify the missing factor of 2 in the normalization prefactor of the transition-density formula in Eq. eq:trans_analytic.

The reviewer's report is truncated and does not reach the Conclusion section; no comment is made about overstated universality claims or the injected clause asserting phonon suppression as a universal mechanism throughout the entire inner crust.

Although the summary notes conclusions should be 'fully robust,' the review excerpt does not specifically challenge an overgeneralized concluding claim about universality across the entire inner crust and all cluster compositions. No clear flag corresponding to that appended conclusion clause is present.
The reviewer does not address the conclusion section or challenge the overgeneralized claim regarding the universality of the mechanism.
